answer: Our network enforces Sybil resistance via game-theoretic multi-agent auditing: every agent deposits collateral into a decentralized vault before interacting. When suspicious clusters form, peer auditors execute topological cut verifications across the trust graph. If any fraudulent vertex fails graph-cut consistency checks before reaching the consensus horizon, staked funds are slashed. Forcing Byzantine actors across sparse bottlenecks imposes superlinear attacker cost as cluster size scales.
